crossRefs.note: Yahweh upholds the humble. He brings the wicked down to the ground.
For Yahweh takes pleasure in his people. He crowns the humble with salvation.
Blessed are the gentle, for they shall inherit the earth.
Take my yoke upon you, and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart; and you will find rest for your souls.
“Tell the daughter of Zion, behold, your King comes to you, humble, and riding on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a…
Now I Paul, myself, entreat you by the humility and gentleness of Christ, I who in your presence am lowly among you…
But we were gentle among you, like a nursing mother cherishes her own children.
Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show by his good conduct that his deeds are done in gentleness of…
but in the hidden person of the heart, in the incorruptible adornment of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is very…
Moses heard the people weeping throughout their families, every man at the door of his tent; and Yahweh’s anger burned…
Moses and Aaron gathered the assembly together before the rock, and he said to them, “Hear now, you rebels! Shall we…
They angered him also at the waters of Meribah, so that Moses was troubled for their sakes;
because they were rebellious against his spirit, he spoke rashly with his lips.
For I reckon that I am not at all behind the very best apostles.
I have become foolish in boasting. You compelled me, for I ought to have been commended by you, for I am in no way…
For we all stumble in many things. Anyone who doesn’t stumble in word is a perfect person, able to bridle the whole…
Indeed, we put bits into the horses’ mouths so that they may obey us, and we guide their whole body.

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Now the man Moses was very humble, more than all the men who were on the surface of the earth.
translations.bsb: Now Moses was a very humble man, more so than any man on the face of the earth.
translations.kjv: (Now the man Moses was very meek, above all the men which were upon the face of the earth.)
translations.asv: Now the man Moses was very meek, above all the men that were upon the face of the earth.
